info.name: Search Device by Name or Model Number

params.name: key
params.description: Fallback: API key as query parameter (optional for demo)

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the device to search for (e.g., 'iPhone 15 Pro'). Mutually exclusive with 'model_number'.

params.name: model_number
params.description: Model number of the device to search for (e.g., 'A3520'). Mutually exclusive with 'name'.

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: Optional. Filter search results to devices from this manufacturer only. If no devices match the manufacturer, returns empty results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Optional. Number of results to return per page (default: 10, max: 30). Use this to control how many devices are returned in the response. For example, limit=1 returns only the best match.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (default: 1). Each page contains 50 devices.

params.name: exact
params.description: Set to true for exact matching (default: false). When true, only returns devices with 100% match certainty (exact name or exact model number match).

items.docs: Retrieve device details by providing either a device name (e.g., 'iPhone 15 Pro') or a model number (e.g., 'A3520'), but not both. At least one parameter is required. Results are paginated (default: 10 per page, customizable via 'limit' parameter). Optionally filter by manufacturer. Exact model number matches are prioritized over name matches. **Note**: `image_b64` returns a 100x100 thumbnail.
